text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Seeking the Pearl—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl was gazing at a crane 
game filled with plushies modeled after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A classmate mentioned it. She said getting 
a "Paka Petit" here is quite a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can't get it easily... That's 
precisely why it's so thrilling, isn't 
it...
choice_data_list: Let me show you the possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
! Heh... That's an interesting thing to 
say. Very well—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Time for a substitution! Show me what 
you're capable of!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
